notes: Sheet is drawn rotated: north arrow points ~28 deg left of page-up. Gilbert Av runs page-vertical down the left edge; only its east side is drawn (east face x~503 at y 1300 to ~400 at y 4100; 100 ft printed; centreline x~230-335, mostly on the left border). E 6th (50 ft) runs page-vertical at x~1160-1255. East Court Street is a chain: (a) SW leg (50 ft, 6 in. pipe) from the Gilbert/E 8th plaza at the bottom left to the corner at (865,3975); (b) a 90 ft dead-end double roadway labelled E. COURT twice (40 ft + 50 ft separated by stone retaining walls) running north from that corner to y 3127, recorded as 'East Court Street (north roadways)'; (c) east leg (50 ft) along the Daylight Building's south side, crossing E 6th; (d) north leg along the Daylight Building's east side; (e) the 40 ft 'E. COURT (CONDEMNED)' alignment curving NNE to the Russell/Elsinore junction; (f) a 60 ft NE leg from that junction to the top edge, passing under the Ida bridge (sheet 143). The 60 ft 'OLD LINE OF E. COURT ST.' (from (2262,1032) SW to (1637,2069), plus its dashed SE line inside the new street) is the superseded line and is not recorded. The street printed RUSSELL ST. (50 ft) at the top is the same street sheet 143 prints ELSINORE (RUSSELL); named Elsinore Street on both sheets so the junction ties. Ida (BRIDGE, rails (2885,205)-(3230,895) and (2990,205)-(3305,860)) runs from the top edge to Monastery; it crosses over East Court's NE leg (grade-separated, centreline crossing off the top edge anyway). Monastery (40 ft) runs NNE from the bottom (bend toward 142) past Oregon and Celestial to the top-right edge. Celestial (50 ft) leaves Monastery SSE, takes Sidereal (printed SIDEREAL, unprinted width ~21 ft, block lines 2052/2116 at its west end) and turns east at the bottom right; the east leg is unlabelled here and named Celestial from the key map (uncertain). Oregon (40 ft) leaves Monastery ESE, bends ENE and runs to the ADAM EDEN PARK INCLINED PLANE at the right edge (pipe ends at ~(3815,3795)); no end recorded because the incline and paper edge are there (the key map shows Oregon reaching Celestial at the incline). The 'INCLINE TO 3RD / INCLINE TO 5TH' curves north of the Daylight Building are garage ramps, not streets. Points in the Gilbert/E 8th plaza and on the curved East Court alignment are approximate (+/-20 px). Scale ~3.39 px/ft.
